summary:
Implemented two iPhone-visible resume improvements:

- Home `Resume Work` now shows up to three compact recent routes under the latest note, so diagnostic call drafts, first checks, and warning-light roadside sessions are one tap away.
- Global Search `Recent Work` can now show `Call draft`, `First checks`, and `Live roadside` together when no saved diagnostic handoff exists yet.

Verification:
- Passed `node --check` for `agent-status.js`, `shared-ui.js`, `search-data.js`, `service-worker.js`
- Passed `git diff --check`
- Passed `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- Passed direct localhost Edge/Playwright probes for Home and Search at 390px, with no horizontal overflow
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')` timed out again, matching the known wrapper-health issue

Updated `AGENT_STATE.md`; PWA cache is now `ridgeline-console-v445`.
